item.text: {"searches":[{"reason":"Develop paired sequence perturbation probes—recent-prefix truncation, order shuffling, and removal of recent versus older interactions—to distinguish sensitivity to current intent from broad historical association. Use training-only held-out prefixes, matched controls, bootstrap uncertainty, and HSTU layer ablations to connect measured ranking changes to specific components without changing benchmark splits.","query":"sequential recommendation temporal shortcut learning counterfactual history perturbation recent intent order sensitivity layer ablation diagnostic probes 2024 2025 2026"},{"reason":"Translate feedback about redundant alternatives and incompatible accessories into evidence-based diagnostics using only titles, descriptions, timestamps, and histories.
